adjudication.rationale: The new webhook handler authenticates requests solely by comparing a single header value to `process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (no signature/HMAC over the body and no freshness check like timestamp/nonce). adjudication.rationale: In `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the request schema only enforces `keys` is a string. The handler then decrypts it and does `JSON.parse(...)` into `keys`, and writes that object directly into `prisma.credential.update/create` as `data: { key: keys }` with no validation against any per-app credential schema (it only looks up `appMetadata.slug/type`).
